targets.title: Saturn
targets.what: A planet ten times as far from the Sun as the Earth, with rings of ice wider than the planet itself. Hundreds of short pictures, and only the sharpest moments kept.

targets.title: The Triangulum Galaxy
targets.sub: Messier 33, a spiral galaxy, going deeper
targets.what: A spiral galaxy 2.7 million light-years away, photographed on 13 October for 16 minutes. Tonight adds two hours.

targets.title: The Orion Nebula
targets.sub: Messier 42, where stars are being born
targets.what: A cloud of gas lit from inside by newborn stars, 1,300 light-years away and bright enough to see with the eye. The longest look of the night.
